details.publicNotes:
Folktales tell of unruly children and argumentative spouses disappearing into the night, never to be seen again. Some of these tales stem from the deeds of rommors—friendly spirits who help people trapped in disparaging and neglectful situations, whisking them away into their magical cloak of a sea of stars and traversing the world to find them a new, loving home.

Unfortunately, many well-intended adventurers have sought to "rescue" those taken by a rommor. When confronted by misguided individuals, a rommor usually attempts to flee and tries only to use violence when absolutely necessary, such as when rescuing someone or protecting one of their wards from harm.

Witness Protection

Sworn to magical secrecy, people once saved by a rommor can't reveal the existence of their supernatural saviors, even when they suspect that a rommor is behind some fresh disappearance. As adventurers are summoned to hunt for a lost person, all these people can do is hint that perhaps the tragic circumstances of the missing folks' lives merit as much investigation as the clues leading toward their discovery.

Suggested Monster Parts

Monster Parts 375/840/1,560 gp

description.value:
You forcibly calm creatures in the area, soothing them into a nonviolent state; each creature must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success Calming urges impose a -1 status penalty to the creature's attack rolls.

Failure Any emotion effects that would affect the creature are suppressed and the creature can't use hostile actions. If the target is subject to hostility from any other creature, it ceases to be affected by calm.

Critical Failure As failure, but hostility doesn't end the effect.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Qr5rgoZvI4KmFY0N]{Spell Effect: Calm}

You and the targets are instantly transported to any location within range, as long as you can identify the location precisely both by its position relative to your starting position and by its appearance (or other identifying features). Incorrect knowledge of the location's appearance usually causes the spell to fail, but it could instead lead to teleporting to an unwanted location or some other unusual mishap determined by the GM. Teleport is not precise over great distances. The targets appear at a distance from the intended destination equal to roughly 1 percent of the total distance traveled, in a direction determined by the GM. For short journeys, this lack of precision is irrelevant, but for long distances this could be up to 1 mile.

Heightened (7th) You and the other targets can travel to any location within 1,000 miles.

Heightened (8th) You and the other targets can travel to any location on the same planet. If you travel more than 1,000 miles, you arrive only 10 miles off target.

Heightened (9th) You and the other targets can travel to any location on another planet within the same solar system. Assuming you have accurate knowledge of the location's position and appearance, you arrive on the new planet 100 miles off target.

Heightened (10th) As the 9th-rank version, but you and the other targets can travel to any planet within the same galaxy.

target.value: you and up to 4 targets touched, either willing creatures or objects roughly the size of a creature.

description.value:
You concentrate ethereal energy and attack a creature's spirit, dealing 16d6 spirit damage with a basic Fortitude save.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.

You instantly transport yourself and any items you're wearing and holding from your current space to an unoccupied space within range you can see. If this would bring another creature with you—even if you're carrying it in an extradimensional container—the spell is lost.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 1 mile. You don't need to be able to see your destination, as long as you have been there in the past and know its relative location and distance from you. You are then temporarily immune for 1 hour.

You grace the target's mind, boosting its mental defenses and healing its wounds. The target regains 1d10+4 Hit Points when you Cast the Spell and gains a +2 status bonus to saves against mental effects for the duration.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.nkk4O5fyzrC0057i]{Spell Effect: Soothe}

Heightened (+1) The amount of healing increases by 1d10+4.

You create a shroud of darkness that prevents light from penetrating or emanating within the area. Light does not enter the area and any non-magical light sources, such as a torch or lantern, do not emanate any light while inside the area, even if their light radius would extend beyond the darkness. This also suppresses magical light of your darkness spell's rank or lower. Light can't pass through, so creatures in the area can't see outside. From outside, it appears as a globe of pure darkness.

Heightened (4th) Even creatures with darkvision (but not greater darkvision) can barely see through the darkness. They treat targets seen through the darkness as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}.

The target can soar through the air, gaining a fly Speed equal to its Speed or 20 feet, whichever is greater.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.MuRBCiZn5IKeaoxi]{Spell Effect: Fly}

Heightened (7th) The duration increases to 1 hour.

You create a floating, magical hand, either invisible or ghostlike, that grasps the target object and levitates it slowly up to 20 feet in any direction. When you Sustain the spell, you can move the object an additional 20 feet. If the object is in the air when the spell ends, the object falls.

Heightened (3rd) You can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 60 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

Heightened (7th) The range increases to 60 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 2 or less.

1 unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less

description.value:
You hurl a loose, unattended object that is within range and that has 1 Bulk or less at the target. Make a spell attack roll against the target. If you hit, you deal 2d6 bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage—as appropriate for the object you hurled. No specific traits or magic properties of the hurled item affect the attack or the damage.

Critical Success You deal double damage.

Success You deal full damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.

The target can understand all words regardless of language and also speak the languages of other creatures. When in a mixed group of creatures, each time the target speaks, it can choose a creature and speak in a language that creature understands, even if the target doesn't know what language that is.

Heightened (7th) The duration is 8 hours.

Trigger A creature within the rommor's void aura is targeted by an attack

Effect The rommor unleashes shadowy wisps to protect the targeted creature, granting a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack. If the attack misses, the targeted creature can immediately teleport to any unoccupied space within the void aura.

@UUID[Compendium.battlezoo-bestiary-es-pf2e.effects.Item.KwxrXs6skCOxD55y]{Effect: Umbra Shield}

20 feet. Shadows emanates from the rommor, as a 7th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.4GE2ZdODgIQtg51c] spell. Creatures of the rommor's choice gain greater darkvision and a +1 status bonus to AC while they are within the aura.

The rommor unleashes a wave of spiritual energy, dealing @Damage[14d6[spirit]|options:area-damage] damage to creatures in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:20] (@Check[fortitude|dc:33|basic] save). The rommor can exclude any number of creatures in the area from the blast. Creatures that fail the save are knocked 5 feet away from the rommor (or 10 feet on a critical failure). The rommor can't use Spirit Nova again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Spirit Nova]]{1d4 rounds}.

Requirements The rommor's cloak is not already holding 8 creatures

Effect The rommor shrouds an adjacent creature in their cloak, transporting the creature into an extradimensional sea of stars. An unwilling creature can attempt a @Check[will|dc:33] save, after which it becomes temporarily immune to Cloak of Stars for 10 minutes. A willing creature receives the results of a failure, except the rommor can allow the creature to remain in the extradimensional space until the creature wants to leave.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature blinks into the extradimensional space momentarily before reappearing in an unoccupied space of the rommor's choice within the void aura.

Failure The creature is sent into the extradimensional space until the end of its next turn.

Critical Failure As failure, but the creature remains in the extradimensional space for up to 1 minute. The creature can attempt a new Will save to exit the cloak at the end of each of its turns. Each held creature appears as a constellation on the cloak. A rommor can eject a held creature as a free action. If the rommor is slain, all held creatures reappear in the nearest unoccupied space.
